central_idea_and_construction: Exactly two capital L letters as a compact, elegant, friendly LL ligature for a textile workshop. Each L has a tall open loop at its top and a soft sweeping foot at the bottom. Place the second slightly lower to the right; let the two broad ribbon-like strokes meet in one carefully designed under-over crossing with a clean white separation at that crossing. Both L letter paths must remain readable, with large open loops and no more than one crossing. Moderately thick gently varying stroke widths; no hairlines. The outside silhouette is rounded, airy and almost heart-warm, without drawing a heart symbol. Mark occupies roughly 62% width and 65% height at center. Flat monochrome ink, no 3D ribbon shading. Absolutely no square-ended L blocks, nested right-angle brackets, construction beams or angular monogram.
background_role: plain white negative space; no inset outer tile
material: flat ink / pixel clusters; no material rendering
small_size_signature: Two open upper loops and the swept double foot.
specific_risk: An over-complex crossing could look like a knot rather than LL.
reference_transfer: Negative user screenshots analyzed as text: avoid severed slabs and nested squared Ls; no positive visual reference or borrowed signature.
observations: Recorded separately after viewing actual output.
